title: Finance Manager
description:
Position: Finance Manager Department: Finance & Accounts
 Location: Tiruchirappalli
 Reporting To: CEO / CFO 
 Job Summary: 
 The Finance Manager will be responsible for managing the companys internal finance and accounting operations, ensuring accurate accounts, statutory compliance, taxation, payroll, financial reporting, budgeting, and cash flow management. The role requires strong practical knowledge of Indian Accounting, Taxation, GST, TDS, Payroll, PF, ESI and other statutory compliances, along with the ability to manage the finance team and provide financial insights to management. 
 Key Responsibilities: 
 Manage and supervise the companys internal finance and accounts operations. Maintain accurate books of accounts and ensure proper recording of all financial transactions. Handle Indian accounting practices, financial reporting, reconciliations, and month-end closing. Manage GST, TDS, Income Tax, PF, ESI, Professional Tax, and other applicable statutory compliances. Ensure timely filing of all statutory returns and maintain proper compliance records. Manage payroll processing, salary calculations, statutory deductions, and payroll-related compliances. Prepare and review P&L, Balance Sheet, cash flow statements, and other financial reports. Handle GST reconciliation, TDS reconciliation, bank reconciliation, and other accounting reconciliations. Coordinate with auditors, tax consultants, banks, and other financial stakeholders. Handle statutory audits, tax assessments, notices, and related requirements. Prepare and monitor budgets, financial forecasts, and business plans. Monitor cash flow, working capital, company expenses, and payment requirements. Review expenses and identify opportunities for cost control and financial efficiency. Establish and strengthen internal financial controls and accounting processes. Analyze financial data and provide financial insights, trends, risks, and recommendations to management. Ensure proper documentation and compliance for all financial and taxation activities. Supervise, guide, and develop the finance and accounts team. Identify gaps in finance processes and implement improvements for better accuracy and efficiency. Support management in financial planning, business decisions, expansion plans, and other financial requirements. 
 Required Skills: Strong practical knowledge of Indian Accounting and Finance. Strong knowledge of Indian Taxation and Statutory Compliances. Strong knowledge of GST, TDS, Income Tax, PF, ESI, Professional Tax, and other applicable compliances. Strong knowledge of Payroll processing and payroll compliances. Strong financial reporting, budgeting, forecasting, and cash flow management skills. Expert in MS Excel and computer applications. Strong analytical, problem-solving, reporting, and decision-making skills. Strong leadership and team management skills. Good English communication and interpersonal skills. Good knowledge of accounting software; Zoho Books knowledge will be an added advantage. 
 Qualification: Degree in Accounts & Finance only. CA / CMA qualification will be an added advantage. 
 Experience: Minimum 5 years of experience in Finance & Accounts. Strong hands-on experience in Indian Accounting, Taxation, Statutory Compliance, Payroll, and Financial Reporting is mandatory. Prior experience managing internal company accounts and finance teams is preferred. 
 Key Performance Indicators (KPIs): Accuracy and timely completion of accounting activities. Timely statutory filings and compliance. Accuracy of payroll and statutory deductions. GST and TDS reconciliation and compliance. Timely preparation of financial statements and management reports. Budget and cash flow management. Audit and tax assessment closure. Internal control effectiveness. Cost control and financial efficiency. Finance team productivity and process efficiency. 
 Preferred Candidate Profile: Strong hands-on experience in Indian Accounts, Taxation, Compliance, and Payroll. Thorough knowledge of GST, TDS, Income Tax, PF, ESI, Professional Tax and related statutory requirements. Experience in handling complete internal finance and accounting operations of a company. Strong experience in financial reporting, reconciliations, budgeting, and cash flow management. Excellent knowledge of MS Excel. Zoho Books knowledge will be an added advantage. Strong team management and leadership capabilities. Ability to independently manage finance, accounts, taxation, payroll, and compliance activities. Good English communication skills. Candidates willing to relocate can also apply. Immediate joiners preferred.

Key Skills: Gst,Finance,Processing,Budgeting,Indian,Statutory,Balance,Finance control
